name: DocBank: A Benchmark Dataset for Fine-Grained Document Layout Analysis
description: DocBank is a large-scale multimodal benchmark dataset for fine-grained document layout analysis. Constructed by researchers from Beihang University and Microsoft Research Asia, DocBank contains 500,000 document pages extracted from arXiv scientific papers published between 2014 and 2018. The dataset provides token-level bounding boxes and typography attributes paired with 12 semantic layout structure categories (abstract, author, caption, equation, figure, footer, list, paragraph, reference, section, table, title). Annotations are derived via weak supervision from LaTeX source codes, supporting both visual object detection and text-based sequence labeling formulations.

verification.notes: Verified against doc-analysis.github.io/docbank-page/ and COLING 2020 paper (arXiv:2006.01038). Confirmed 500,000 pages (400k train, 50k dev, 50k test), 12 token-level layout categories, weak-supervision provenance, and no-redistribution research license.

size.notes: Full dataset distribution containing 500,000 page images alongside token-level coordinate and label text files.

citation.paper_title: DocBank: A Benchmark Dataset for Document Layout Analysis

provenance.collection_method: Weakly-supervised automatic extraction from arXiv LaTeX source files and digital PDFs across 2014 to 2018.
provenance.curation_notes: Distinguishes from TableBank by annotating 12 comprehensive structural units across the entire page layout at token level rather than isolating tabular structures.
data_sources: arXiv.org open-access scientific publication source packages
